claim: Under the gate's own rule and the paired draw, go2-c2 (trained on the Go2's DECLARED joints: armature 0.01/0.02, no joint damping or friction) still passes with a real Go2's MEASURED joints set in: at the IIT chirp fit's armature, damping and Coulomb friction together it tracks 17/20 [0.621, 0.968], exactly at the gate's floor of 0.85 (certificate 38/40 minus 0.10), so it holds - by no margin. Alone, the fit's friction costs one trial (17/20), damping none (18/20), armature none (19/20). The ladders say where the margin runs out: added joint friction falls at 1 N*m (15/20), inside the fit's own 0.10-1.33 N*m span; armature survives 4x and damping 0.5 N*m*s/rad. First by the rung they fall at: kp 0.8x (15/20) and kd 2x (16/20), then latency 2 ticks (0/20, the only collapse), payload 6 kg, tilt 8 deg, push 2 m/s; friction scaled to 0.2x and encoder noise survive.
instrument: plain MuJoCo 3.11.0 + onnxruntime driven by the manifest alone, CPU, the WSL machine (Ubuntu under WSL2, x86_64); every rung 20 paired held twists at the gate's own seed 1000 (per-trial draw)

sources.rule: the operator's decision of 2026-09-25: the gate's own tolerance rule

caveats: Sim only: the knobs and the fit are set on plain MuJoCo's model; no hardware behaviour is claimed, and the DDS runtime was not swept.

The fit is a public log's: IIT's Go2 in the air under a PD chirp, its torque modelled from the command, 31/36 terms pinned; four hip armatures and one calf friction were not pinned. It is a real Go2's joints, not ours.

At 20 trials the tolerance rule's margin is one to three trials: the baseline reads 18/20 and the floor is 17/20 (0.85), so 'holds at the fit' is 17/20 exactly at the floor and kp 0.8x / kd 2x fell by three and two trials. The one collapse is latency 2 ticks (0/20). A decision on these margins wants 40 trials per rung.
The ranking compares rung indices across knobs of different units: kp and kd rank first because they fell at their FIRST rung, not because they fell hardest.
Rungs are set at the fit's point estimates; the fit's intervals are not swept here (that is the randomization the parked item 1 trains under).
